author: Ran, Yang, et al.

steps.title: Prepare reagents and equipment
steps.instruction: Synthesize mammalian expression vectors for AARS1/2 and siRNAs targeting AARS1/2. Culture HEK293T (ATCC 3216) and HeLa (ATCC CCL‑2) cells in DMEM (Fisher Scientific, Cat#31966047) with 10 % (v/v) FBS (Gibco, Cat#10270106), 100 mg/mL penicillin‑streptomycin (Invitrogen, Cat#15140‑122). Maintain at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, humidified. Test for mycoplasma with EZ PCR Mycoplasma detection Kit (Biological Industries, Cat#20‑700‑20). Refresh medium every 48 h by removing half of the old medium (avoid disturbing spheroids) and adding an equal volume of fresh medium. Calibrate the Orbitrap Exploris 480 LC‑MS/MS system and run HeLa cell lysate QC samples.

steps.title: Culture HEK293T cells for transfection
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm DMEM, PBS and trypsin‑EDTA in a 37 °C water bath. Seed HEK293T cells in a 10 cm dish and grow at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until 80‑90 % confluent. Aspirate growth medium and wash twice with 2 mL sterile PBS. Remove PBS, add 1 mL trypsin‑EDTA and incubate ~30 s at 37 °C until cells detach. Neutralize with 2 mL growth medium, pipette to detach remaining cells. Transfer suspension to a 15 mL Falcon tube, centrifuge 3 min at 200 × g, 22‑25 °C. Discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1 mL fresh growth medium. Seed one‑quarter of this suspension into a new 10 cm dish, add 8 mL fresh growth medium, and culture until optimal confluency for transfection.

steps.title: Prepare transfection reagents (Table 1)
steps.instruction: For each treatment prepare at least two 10 cm dishes of cells. Use the amounts listed in Table 1 for siRNA, plasmid DNA, PEI or Lipofectamine RNAiMAX. siRNA stocks are 20‑100 µM in RNase‑free water. Dilute the required siRNA or plasmid in serum‑free DMEM (see Table 1). Dilute PEI or Lipofectamine RNAiMAX in serum‑free DMEM (see Table 1). Combine diluted nucleic acid with diluted transfection reagent and incubate 20 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfect HEK293T cells
steps.instruction: Grow cells to 40‑50 % confluency. Add the DNA/siRNA‑PEI/Lipofectamine mix dropwise to the plates. Incubate 6 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Aspirate the transfection medium and replace with fresh DMEM.

steps.title: Set up LC‑MS/MS system
steps.instruction: Install fresh mobile solvent A and solvent B (sonicate both to remove bubbles). Flush air from pump A, pump B and pump S with mobile phase buffer (flush threshold 10 µL). Activate the analytical column with 90 % solvent B for 10 µL. Equilibrate the column by running a blank sample (≈30 min). Note: installation, flushing and activation may take ~1 h.

steps.title: Prepare Klac enrichment samples
steps.instruction: Dissolve enriched Klac peptides in 5 µL 0.1 % formic acid (solvent A). Centrifuge 12 000 × g for 20 min at 4 °C. Transfer 4.5 µL supernatant to autosampler vials and load 4 µL onto an Easy‑nLC 1200 HPLC.

steps.title: Prepare proteome samples
steps.instruction: Dissolve the peptides obtained in step 39 in 20 µL 0.1 % formic acid (solvent A). Centrifuge 12 000 × g for 20 min at 4 °C. Transfer 18 µL supernatant to autosampler vials and load 1 µL onto an Easy‑nLC 1200 HPLC.

steps.title: Run MS acquisition (Orbitrap Exploris 480)
steps.instruction: Set the mass spectrometer to positive ion mode. Use a spray voltage of 2.0 kV (increase to 2.1 kV if the emitter is stained or worn). Set heated capillary temperature to 320 °C. Full MS: resolution 60 000, max injection time 25 ms, m/z range 350–1400, AGC target 1 × 10⁶. MS/MS (HCD): resolution 15 000, max injection time 22 ms, Top20 method, m/z range 200–1400, AGC target 5 × 10⁴, max injection time 45 ms, isolation window 1.6 m/z, normalized collision energy 27 % (adjust as needed for other instruments).
